description: Follow-on from the bedrock-q67.43 discussion (2026-08-21): value-level protocol violations get explicit clauses with inline structured exits (OTP idiom, precedented by metadata_coverage_gap); shape-level impossibilities keep assertive-match fallthrough. Convert the resolver's stale-window preclusion comment (same-epoch call with last_version < t.last_version) into a clause exiting {:stale_window_re_presented, floor: ..., got: ...}, pinned by catch_exit. Forensics: the crash names the violated invariant instead of an anonymous FunctionClauseError requiring comment archaeology.
title: Resolver stale-window preclusion becomes a named-exit assertion
